hero.subtitle: Raindrop keeps your bookmarks on its servers — and charges you every year. BookmarkForge keeps them on your computer, locked with a key only you have. No accounts. No monthly fees. No one reading over your shoulder.

pocketAlternative.title: The Private Pocket Alternative
pocketAlternative.subtitle: Pocket is going away. BookmarkForge keeps the read-it-later habit alive — with every article, note and highlight stored encrypted on your device.

features.title: Read It Later, Yours Forever
features.text: Save articles, videos and PDFs with one click — from the PWA, browser extension or share menu. Unlike Pocket, your reading list lives on your device, encrypted, and still works offline.

features.title: Notion-Style Notes on Every Article
features.text: Highlight, summarize and take block-based notes attached to any bookmark. Turn a saved article into your own knowledge base — not just a link list.

features.title: Zero Tracking, Zero Ads
features.text: BookmarkForge has no accounts, no analytics and no ads by default. Your reading habits are nobody's business but yours.

raindropCompare.title: BookmarkForge vs Raindrop, without the fine print
raindropCompare.subtitle: Raindrop is a good app. The big difference is where your stuff lives.

rows.topic: Who can read what you save
rows.us: Nobody — locked with your key, not even us
rows.them: The company, and whoever demands it of them

rows.us: Nothing changes — it is already in your hands
Runs inside your computer in private mode — nothing is sent anywhere
rows.them: Your reading goes off to the cloud to think

raindropCompare.ctaPrimary: Try it free in 2 minutes — no account
raindropCompare.close: Raindrop is simpler and free — if that is all you need, use it happily. But if you would rather keep your reading life in your own hands, BookmarkForge is built for exactly that.

features.title: Everything you need, in plain words

items.title: Bookmarks & documents
items.text: Save any page with one click. Write notes right next to it, in a clean, simple editor. Stays fast even with 100,000 saved items.

items.title: Smart search
items.text: Find things by keyword or by meaning — even when you do not remember the exact words. Raindrop charges 28 dollars a year for this; here it is included free.

items.title: An AI that reads your library, inside your computer
items.text: Ask questions about what you saved and get answers with the sources shown. Nothing is sent to the cloud, and it works without internet. Requires Pro.

items.title: Chat with your own library
items.text: Ask anything about your bookmarks and notes and get cited answers. The private mode runs 100% on your machine. Requires Pro.

items.title: Sync between your own devices
items.text: Your devices talk to each other directly — no server in the middle, and everything stays encrypted. Pair them by scanning a QR code. Up to 5 devices. Requires Pro.

items.title: Backups you own
items.text: Automatic backups you can keep wherever you like — an external drive, a cloud folder, anywhere. Export everything to Markdown, JSON, CSV or PDF whenever you want. You hold the keys.

items.title: A map of your knowledge
items.text: See how your notes and bookmarks connect. Filter by tags, dates and similarity, and zoom around an endless canvas.

items.title: Study cards that beat forgetting
items.text: Turn any saved document into question cards that resurface right before you would forget them — the same scheduling idea as Anki. Requires Pro.

items.title: Private by default
items.text: No accounts, no tracking, no ads. You are the customer, not the product. Usage sharing exists, it is optional and stays off until you turn it on.

ai.title: Your Knowledge, Amplified
ai.subtitle: Run the assistant inside your computer — nothing leaves it, and it works offline. Prefer a big cloud model? Connect your own key: your questions and the pages needed to answer them go to that provider, at your cost. Your prompts, your data, your rules.

list.name: Inside your computer — WebLLM models (TinyLlama, Llama 3.2, Phi-3.5-mini) — Pro only
On your own machine — Ollama (any model you run)
Cloud — Google Gemini (key managed by us)
Cloud — OpenAI / GPT-4o (with your own key)
Cloud — Anthropic Claude (with your own key)
Cloud — OpenRouter or another custom provider (with your own key)

items.title: Private Mode
items.text: The assistant runs entirely inside your computer. Nothing leaves it, and it needs no internet. Requires Pro.

items.title: Web Search Mode
items.text: Combines your library with live results from the web (cloud providers).

items.title: Expert Agents
items.text: Specialized helpers: Coder, Writer, Analyst and Researcher. Requires Pro.

privacy.title: Privacy Isn't a Feature — It's the Foundation
privacy.subtitle: Every architectural decision puts you in control

items.title: Locked so nobody can read it — not even us
items.text: Your library is encrypted with a key derived from your master password. We never see your password or your content.

items.title: Stored on your own device
items.text: Everything lives on your computer. The companion server only handles licensing, device pairing and relaying your cloud-mode AI questions — never your content.

items.title: No tracking by default
items.text: No analytics, no crash reports, no tracking. Sharing usage stats or error reports is a separate choice, off by default.

items.title: You hold the keys
items.text: No master password means no access — there is no "forgot password" backdoor. Your 24-word recovery phrase is the only way in; keep it safe.

items.title: Your rights, respected
items.text: Access, correct, erase or take your data with you — all doable locally, whenever you want.

items.title: No lock-in
items.text: Export your data anytime in open formats (JSON, Markdown, CSV, PDF). Your knowledge stays yours and portable.

items.question: Is the Free tier really free forever?
items.answer: Yes. No trial, no subscription. The free tier includes 2,500 bookmarks, full-text & semantic search, knowledge graph, and AI with your own API key (you pay the provider).

items.question: What does "Lifetime of v1" mean for Pro?
items.answer: Pay once, own v1 forever. Includes all v1.x updates (bugfixes + minor features) forever and 12 months of feature updates from purchase. Security updates forever. After month 13 you keep v1 functional, just without new features. Future major versions (v2, v3) are separate products: $89 for new customers, $35 for v1 owners (60% off).

items.question: What payment methods & refunds?
items.answer: Via Whop: credit card, PayPal, crypto. We never see your payment details. 30-day refund — contact bookmarkforge@proton.me.

items.question: Support — how fast do you answer?
items.answer: Free: Community help via Help Center + GitHub Discussions (best effort). Pro: email 48h business days. Vault is encrypted — we cannot see your data, so we never ask for your password or recovery phrase. See Support SLA.

items.question: What if I forget my vault password?
items.answer: We cannot recover it. When you create a vault we show 24-word recovery phrase once — write it on paper. Without it, no one (including us) can open the vault. See BF-E101.
